name: Test Meshery Integration

  pull_request:
    branches:

    paths-ignore:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    - name: Checkout code

    - name: Set up Node.js 20
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '20'
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Build Sistent
      run: npm run build

    - name: Package Sistent
      run: npm pack

    - name: Upload package to GitHub release (if needed)
      id: upload-release
      uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
        asset_path: dist/*.tgz
        asset_name: sistent.tgz
        asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

    - name: Clone Meshery UI repository
      run: git clone https://github.com/meshery/meshery.git

    - name: Navigate to Meshery UI directory
      working-directory: meshery/ui

    - name: Install Meshery UI dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Install Sistent package
      run: npm install ../dist/sistent.tgz

    - name: Run Meshery UI build
      run: npm run build

    - name: Run Meshery UI tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Report test results
      uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
      with:
        name: 'Sistent Meshery UI Integration Test'
        path: './coverage/lcov.info'
        reporter: 'lcov'

    - name: Check for test failures
      id: check-failures
      run: |
        if grep -E '"test"\s*:' coverage/lcov.info | grep -q 'FAIL'; then
          echo "::set-output name=fail::true"
        else
          echo "::set-output name=fail::false"
        fi

    - name: Set PR check status
      if: ${{ steps.check-failures.outputs.fail == 'true' }}
      run: echo "::set-output name=conclusion::failure"
      else
        echo "::set-output name=conclusion::success"
      fi

name: Test Meshery Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**'
      - '*.md'

jobs:
  test-meshery-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js 20
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '20'
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Build Sistent
      run: npm run build

    - name: Package Sistent
      run: npm pack

    - name: Upload package to GitHub release (if needed)
      id: upload-release
      uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
        asset_path: dist/*.tgz
        asset_name: sistent.tgz
        asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

    - name: Clone Meshery UI repository
      run: git clone https://github.com/meshery/meshery.git

    - name: Navigate to Meshery UI directory
      working-directory: meshery/ui

    - name: Install Meshery UI dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Install Sistent package
      run: npm install ../dist/sistent.tgz

    - name: Run Meshery UI build
      run: npm run build

    - name: Run Meshery UI tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Report test results
      uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
      with:
        name: 'Sistent Meshery UI Integration Test'
        path: './coverage/lcov.info'
        reporter: 'lcov'

    - name: Check for test failures
      id: check-failures
      run: |
        if grep -E '"test"\s*:' coverage/lcov.info | grep -q 'FAIL'; then
          echo "::set-output name=fail::true"
        else
          echo "::set-output name=fail::false"
        fi

    - name: Set PR check status
      if: ${{ steps.check-failures.outputs.fail == 'true' }}
      run: echo "::set-output name=conclusion::failure"
      else
        echo "::set-output name=conclusion::success"
      fi
